most_interesting_result: Sabni supplies the densest single operational cluster; Punt supplies the reverse logistics mirror; Sinuhe supplies the semantic HOME -> FOREIGN LAND -> HOME_PRIME loop. Together they cover much of the decomposed dream graph, but they remain independent texts and must not be fused into a single ancient narrative.

supported: Open-access Egyptian records contain strong partial structural parallels to several nodes of the decomposed dream.
Sabni contains an unusually dense cluster of companion-title, goods/textiles/oils, foreign lands, family retrieval and transport.
Punt places loading and homeward return from a foreign land in sequence.
Sinuhe strongly parallels the semantic home-exile-return loop.
not_supported: The friend's dream is an ancient Egyptian text, prophecy or prediction.
Ancient texts describe a modern aircraft or motorhome.
Sabni, Punt, Sinuhe and Dream Book may be merged into one historical procedure.
Lexical or structural similarity proves historical transmission or supernatural causation.

promotion_gate: Find one ancient local text or tightly connected procedure that independently closes at least four sequential edges among dream/vision, companion/helper, household token/cargo, load/carry, foreign-land journey, wing/flying motif and return/homecoming. Until then keep SINGLE_TEXT_CLOSURE = NOT_YET.
